name: Camp Mah-Kee-Nac
description_short: A traditional overnight camp for boys in Lenox in the Berkshires, for boys entering grades 2 to 11. Campers choose electives from sports, waterfront, outdoor adventure, STEM, media and arts, and live in bunks grouped by grade. Families choose a 7 week full season, a 4 or 3 week session, or a 2 week Mini Mak session for younger boys.

notes: 2027 rates include tuition, laundry and towel service. A required trip and special event fee is extra and varies by age. Sibling discounts are offered.
